author: BourbonBonobo
body:
Hello All,

  Ok,  back before the Omega update, there was this pretty awesome thing, called team chat, where you could exchange tactical information, talk with friends, all on one private chat (Your Team). So why in the world was it removed? I'm really confused. The whole idea of the team chat system in my opinion was pretty awesome... and it was! Is there any chance that the Team Chat could ever return back to the gameplay of avicus? I understand how this may have some negative things about it, such as, Spam. So just think about it! DO you think Team Chat should come back? Or should we just keep the same chat layout?

-Wrecky
